source_metadata.title: Connecting Ridge observational terrain demonstration

sources.title: LOLA 5 m Connecting Ridge DEM
sources.projection: South polar stereographic, lon0=0, lat0=-90, spherical radius1737400m
sources.source_citation: Barker et al. (2021), Planetary and Space Science203,105119, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119
sources.note: Published source surface already interpolates empty LOLA pixels; no additional missing pixel filling is performed by this pipeline.

sources.title: Adjusted LOLA south-polar 80 m DEM
sources.source_citation: Barker et al., A New View of the Lunar South Pole from LOLA, NASA PGDA product90
sources.note: Full upstream GeoTIFF downloaded with verified HTTPS; crop covers200km square around the pole. Both raw source and derived crop hashes recorded.

sources.title: NASA CGI Moon Kit LROC colour map
sources.role: Appearance only; never used to calculate surface heights or illumination. NASA map includes inpainting/polar synthesis described on the source page.

limitations: Only three prepared Connecting Ridge points have the packaged terrain profiles. A globe pin outside these points has coordinates, not a new validated terrain analysis.
The 5 m surface is an interpolated LOLA product; 5 m pixel spacing is not 5 m accuracy or a guarantee of obstacle detection.
Numerical horizon coverage is finite:0.5 degree azimuth and up to80km with distance-dependent radial sampling; far terrain has80m native pixels.
At the 5m/80m footprint seam the two independently adjusted products can disagree; no blending is used to hide that difference.
3D display mesh is decimated to20m spacing. Numerical profiles use separately sampled source terrain.
These calculated scenarios are educational engineering estimates. They are not certified landing, safety, or flight products.

ephemeris_metadata.source: JPL NAIF SPICE kernels supplied with LunaShift_v5
ephemeris_metadata.time_conversion: UTC passed through naif0012.tls to ephemeris time; hourly UTC grid
ephemeris_metadata.limitations: Geometric positions omit light-time and stellar aberration. Body-centred positions must be translated to the selected surface observer before local angles are computed. One-hour interpolation is an approximation; event times also depend on browser sampling and DEM resolution.

v7_extension.source: Supplied DE421 SPK and lunar PCK kernels, evaluated using documented type-2 Chebyshev records
v7_extension.earth_orientation: IAU_EARTH from pck00011.tpc; not high-accuracy ITRF/EOP
v7_extension.quaternion_convention: x,y,z,w; ECEF to MOON_ME_DE421; slerp between samples
v7_extension.limitations: Geometric simultaneous positions; no light time, refraction, atmosphere model, station scheduling or Earth-orientation-parameter corrections. UTC conversion follows bundled naif0012.tls over 2026-2027.
v7_extension.note: Terrain and Sun reused from supplied v6; Earth evaluated from supplied verified v5 kernels. No new terrain download in v7.
